item.tib: bzlas chog rin chen sgron ma'i kha tshar las zlog pa'i cha lag ye shes me dpung
item.coloph: tshul dbang lhang lhang mched grogs dam pa'i nan tan du/ yang yang bskul ngor bla ming tshul dbang gis/ mang mang bris pa'i nyes 'gal ci mchis pa/ mkhas mkhas mkhyen pa'i spyan ldan tshogs la bshags/ 'di bris dge ba'i ma gyur 'gro ba rnams/ mi mthun log pa'i dgra tshogs rab zhi nas/ mthun rkyen tshe bsod dpal 'byor rab 'phel zhing / myur du bla med go 'phang thob par shog/
